subject.title: fix(agent): treat Anthropic long-context usage errors as context overflow for compact+retry

question: Should this PR implement the compact-then-failover terminal for the Anthropic long-context 429 before merge, or should maintainers explicitly accept compaction-only blocked behavior for this specific body?
rationale: Both paths change user-visible provider routing and session state, and a MEMBER review has already requested the compact-then-failover shape while the contributor argues for classifier-only scope.

options.title: Require compact then failover
options.body: Keep the overflow classification but block merge until exhausted compaction can produce a failoverable terminal result with replay-safety and larger-context gating.

options.title: Accept classifier-only scope
options.body: Clear the existing requested-changes review and intentionally let this Anthropic body join the current compaction-only blocked overflow contract.

options.title: Defer to the canonical issue
options.body: Pause or close this PR and keep the broader overflow-to-fallback design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/9986.

recommendation.title: Require compact then failover
recommendation.body: Keep the overflow classification but block merge until exhausted compaction can produce a failoverable terminal result with replay-safety and larger-context gating.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned, authored the unresolved CHANGES_REQUESTED review, and current-main blame points to him on the affected fallback/overflow surfaces.
